info.title: KidQ API
info.description: Content curation, KidQ content score, admin publishing and recommendations. Spec: docs/recommendation/README.md and docs/content-curation/README.md.

capped_by.description: The failed check that capped this part, e.g. rapid_visual_cuts; never set on an admin's score

credits.description: The source's full attribution: story, illustrations, translation, publisher and license

categories.description: Every category the item fits (at most three), primary first

parent_category.description: The parent category (one of the seven) the primary category rolls up to; show this to parents

parent_categories.description: Every parent category the item falls under, primary first

session_modes.description: Times of day the item suits (MORNING, DAYTIME, BEDTIME); empty fits any

kidq_check.description: The parent-facing trust badge: plain words per dimension, never a number. Parent screens show this, not content_score

learning.description: What the child can learn or do, kept separate from the KidQ score: 25 points per area (Thinking, Language, Feelings & friends, Doing)

languages.description: Content languages the parent chose (keys from GET /taxonomy); defaults to the parent's language

interests.description: Block A. Empty broadens the feed; it never narrows it.

content_mix.description: Block B. SURPRISE: an age-appropriate mix. CHOSEN: only preferred_categories.

preferred_categories.description: Block B: parent category keys (GET /taxonomy → parent_category); sending some without content_mix means CHOSEN

development_goals.description: Block C: never asked. Omit, or send [], for the age-band defaults.

regulation_goals.description: Block D. Empty or all six means no restriction.

session_minutes.description: Block E: session length; the breaks follow from it

break_type.description: Block E: MOVEMENT, QUIET or ALTERNATE

break_interval_minutes.description: Block E: minutes between breaks (10, 15 or 20); breaks = duration ÷ interval, rounded

session_mode.description: §12: AUTO follows the clock; MORNING, DAYTIME or BEDTIME is remembered until changed

age_band.description: The band today: the one the parent picked, moved on as the child grows

age_years.description: Estimated from the band and the time since it was set

break_plan.description: One break per break interval; the last is always the wind-down

short_by_minutes.description: How far the child's library fell short of the chosen time; 0 when it filled it

time_band.description: The band India's clock was in when the session started

opener.description: The KidQ Agent's opener, played before slot 1 and outside the chosen minutes

wind_down.description: How the last slot closes: SLEEP is the full sleep wind-down

planned_seconds.description: The chosen time: the sun's whole arc

progress_seconds.description: Watched so far, each video counted up to its length: rewatching never moves the sun on

break_after.description: The break after this slot; the last is always WIND_DOWN, shown in child mode as the sunset

id.description: The activity id, for activity_started / activity_completed events

spoken_instruction.description: Read aloud by the device voice (en-IN)

variant.description: e.g. the colour for Find 3 things; for the sunset, the session's wind_down

vs_previous.description: Only when both periods have screen time

categories.description: Videos and activities; past the top five is "other"

engaged.description: Up to three, from watch time, completion, repeats and variety; a category needs two plays

insights.description: At most two factual sentences, only once there's enough to go on

children_active.description: Children with any viewing in this period
